schema_language.reference_rule: every ref target resolves to exactly one schema id; references are schema-directed and expand once per validation position
schema_language.recursion_measure: SCHEMA-SCHEMA-NODE recursion consumes one strict child node of a finite manifest value; no reference may recur without structural descent
schema_language.union_rule: select exactly one variant by the exact kind tag; zero or multiple variants reject
schema_language.post_schema_validator_rule: after complete structural admission, execute validators by ascending stage_order then unsigned UTF-8 id; each validator consumes only its declared input schema and operator; the first failure rejects
schema_language.validation_failure_rule: a validator failure path substitutes the current input path and zero-based row index into failure_path_template; mutation bypass removes only its named validator and changes no value or other stage

rule_provenance.summary: Expand consumes exactly one accepted LockedSource and returns complete success or NAMESPACE_COLLISION.
One module instance exists per rooted import-edge path, not per selected package.
Namespace segments are exact aliases and render only by :: joining.
Instance traversal is source-index depth-first pre-order.
Different paths to one selected package remain separate instances and traversal terminates on the accepted acyclic graph.
Imported copied modules receive the exact PC4 default algorithm without changing root or retained parsed values.
Exactly eight declaration collections and their exact discriminators are flattened.
Every expanded declaration has the exact six-member record.
Root records precede imported records and preserve root array order.
Imported records use instance order then source array order; Sort remains later.
Effective names derive only from valid collection discriminators; invalid headers remain with null names.
Collision keys are collection plus effective name, require imported participation, and never cross collections.
Collision precedence and path use collection rank, name bytes, zero-based numeric collection ordinals, and the second record.
Success has the exact eight-member source-bound structure and complete root/import provenance.
Expand creates no identity, artifact, or authority.
Reference contexts map direct aliases to child namespace paths while body interpretation remains Normalize-owned.
NAMESPACE_COLLISION is the only semantic failure and returns no partial success.
Ambient and resource state cannot change a semantic Expand result.
The specified manifest has closed schemas, populations, references, constructions, concrete discriminators, isolated mutations, and maturity claims.

construction_protocol.root_rule: root_source_utf8 is exact UTF-8 without BOM or trailing newline; run accepted PC2, PC3, PC4, and PC5, and require exact equality to expected_defaulted_root_json and expected_root_blueprint_digest
construction_protocol.package_rule: parse package_modules_json as a UTF-8-sorted array of exact name/version/module_source_utf8 records; module_source_utf8 is exact retained module.yaml bytes; SHA-256 it, construct the six-member package descriptor with profile lattice-core-0.1 and one module.yaml file row, canonical-encode it, and require exact descriptor bytes, package ids, and module hashes from the expected JSON fields
construction_protocol.snapshot_rule: construct one immutable PortableProjectSnapshot with directory entries packages, packages/<name>, packages/<name>/1.0.0 and file entries package.yaml=descriptor_utf8 and module.yaml=module_source_utf8 for every record; no symlink, metadata variance, unlisted file, or ambient path exists
construction_protocol.expected_rule: derive every expected value before PC9 invocation; expected_json is complete canonical JSON for the success semantic projection or exact diagnostic; the exact LockedSource member is compared directly to input and represented by the exact_input sentinel only in the retained projection
construction_protocol.construction_hash_rule: construction_sha256 is lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of the exact UTF-8 bytes of the Canonical JSON Erratum encoding of an object with exactly existing_lock_utf8, package_modules_json, and root_source_utf8; each string value is the exact manifest JSON string value and is escaped only by that canonical encoder, JSON null remains null, and no decoding, concatenation, normalization, line-ending change, terminator, BOM, or domain separator is added; the field is non-normative criteria provenance only and is not a Lattice identity, Expand operation input, output, artifact, or operation preimage
